---
title: "QTL Exploration: Specificity & Hotspots"
author: "sysgenAnalysis"
format: html
server: shiny
---

## Setup Environment

```{r}
#| message: false
if (!requireNamespace("sysgenAnalysis", quietly = TRUE)) {
    devtools::install_github("AttieLab-Systems-Genetics/sysgenAnalysis")
}
library(sysgenAnalysis)
library(DT)
library(shiny)
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
# NOTE: If rendering from the package library, use 'quarto render ... --execute-dir .'
# to ensure relative paths below resolve to your project directory.
proj_root <- if (dir.exists("byandell/output")) "." else "../.."
save_dir <- file.path(proj_root, "byandell/output")
output_path <- file.path(save_dir, "QTL_Differential_Analysis")
```

## Load Results from CSVs

```{r load-results}
qtl_res <- sysgenAnalysis::read_qtl_analysis(output_path)
```

## Results

### Summary

```{r}
DT::datatable(summary(qtl_res, type = "hotspots"))
```

### Specificity Table

```{r}
if (!is.null(qtl_res$summary_table)) {
    DT::datatable(summary(qtl_res, type = "specificity"))
}
```

### Interactive Manhattan Plot

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar
all_chrs <- unique(qtl_res$plot_data$qtl_chr)
all_classes <- unique(qtl_res$plot_data$trait_class)
max_lod <- max(qtl_res$plot_data$qtl_lod, na.rm = TRUE)

checkboxGroupInput("chrs", "Select Chromosomes:",
                   choices = all_chrs, selected = all_chrs, inline = TRUE)

checkboxGroupInput("classes", "Select Trait Classes:",
                   choices = all_classes, selected = all_classes)

sliderInput("lod", "Minimum LOD Score:",
            min = 0, max = floor(max_lod), value = 7, step = 1)
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill
plotOutput("manhattan_plot", height = "600px")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
output$manhattan_plot <- renderPlot({
  plot(qtl_res, 
       chr = input$chrs, 
       trait_class = input$classes, 
       lod_thresh = input$lod)
})
```
